card.name: Partway into suicidality and reversal terms
card.fires_on: Partway through words in warnings about suicidality, antidepressants, rebound effects or opposite-direction changes, such as 'suic-id', 'antidepress', 'rebound', 'nal-ox'. It also fires on linking words in comparisons like 'higher than' or 'return to'.

modes.label: Grade or range words
modes.description: Numbers or linking words in grading scales and ratio ranges.

card.writes: It leans toward words meaning negative, exceeding or a plus-or-minus range.
card.plain: It lights up in warnings about suicidal thoughts, antidepressants and rebound effects, and in words that mark going beyond a limit.
